lines.unitBasisHelp: A canon unit alias such as ea, day or m.

rfqs.title: Requests for quotation
rfqs.empty: No RFQs yet. Start one to collect sealed quotes from invited vendors.
rfqs.emptyRead: No RFQs yet. Buyers start them here.
rfqs.titleHelp: For example Main stage audio package.
rfqs.noInvitations: No vendors invited yet. Invite at least one before issuing.
rfqs.sealedNotice: Responses stay sealed until the RFQ is closed. Close it at the deadline to compare quotes.
rfqs.openFullHint: Open the full page to manage invitations and compare responses.
rfqs.noResponses: No vendor responded before the RFQ closed.
rfqs.orderBody: A draft purchase order is created with the quoted lines. Unquoted lines stay unpriced until priced.
rfqs.recordHelp: Vendors normally respond in Gateway. Record a quote here when it arrived another way.

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.empty: No purchase orders yet. Create one, or award an RFQ to create it from the winning quote.
orders.emptyRead: No purchase orders on your projects yet.
orders.vendorHelp: Blocked and canceled vendors take no new orders, so they are not listed.
orders.noLines: No lines yet. Add what is being ordered; a line without a price stays unpriced.
orders.linesLocked: Lines are locked after approval. Use a change order to change the order.

changes.title: Change orders
changes.empty: No change orders. Raise one when an approved order needs to change.
changes.amountHelp: Negative for a reduction. Leave blank while unpriced; it cannot be approved until priced.

receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.empty: No goods received yet. Record a receipt when a delivery arrives against a purchase order.
receipts.chooseOrderHint: Choose an approved or sent order
receipts.noReceivable: No purchase order is ready to receive. An order must be approved or sent first.
receipts.noneForOrder: Nothing received against this order yet.

matching.title: Invoice matching
matching.empty: No invoices matched yet. Match a payable invoice to its order and receipt before approving it.
matching.emptyNoInvoices: There are no payable invoices to match. Record the vendor's invoice in Finance first.
matching.nothingToMatch: Matching needs a payable invoice and a goods receipt that is not matched yet.
matching.unpricedVariance: Cannot be computed: a price is missing
matching.mismatchBody: Amount, vendor or currency differ from what was ordered and received. Accept the difference with a reason, or dispute the invoice.
matching.mismatchSelf: You recorded this match, so someone else has to accept the difference.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.empty: The org catalog is empty. Add items from the 1,211 canon elements.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.deleteBody: The item ID is never reused. Vendor products bound to it stay recorded.
catalog.noProducts: No vendor sells this item yet. Add a vendor's product and price.
catalog.leadTime: {days, plural, one {# day lead time} other {# days lead time}}
catalog.searchHelp: Search by item name, common name, element ID or URID.
catalog.noElements: No canon element matches. Try fewer words or a URID such as 3000.01.

submittals.title: Submittals
submittals.empty: No submittals yet. Track shop drawings, product data and samples for review here.
submittals.emptyRead: No submittals on this project yet.
submittals.specHelp: The specification section or drawing it answers.

refusals.rfq_no_invitations: Invite at least one vendor before issuing the RFQ.
refusals.rfq_not_open: Responses are accepted only while the RFQ is issued.
refusals.rfq_not_invited: Only an invited vendor can respond to this RFQ.
refusals.rfq_transition_not_allowed: That RFQ move is not allowed from the current state.
refusals.purchase_order_unpriced: Every line needs a price before the order is approved.
refusals.purchase_order_state_conflict: Only a draft purchase order can be approved.
refusals.purchase_order_locked: Lines change only while the order is a draft. Raise a change order instead.
refusals.purchase_order_immutable: A purchase order keeps its project, vendor and currency.
refusals.purchase_order_use_rpc: Approve purchase orders with the Approve button.
refusals.purchase_order_transition_not_allowed: That order move is not allowed from the current state.
refusals.sod_po_creator: Separation of duties: the person who created the purchase order cannot approve it.
refusals.spend_authority_missing: No spend authority lets you approve this document in this currency. Ask a finance approver.
refusals.spend_authority_exceeded: The amount is above your spend authority. Someone with a higher limit has to approve it.
refusals.spend_approval_duplicate: You already approved this. A second, different approver is needed.
refusals.production_closed: The production is closed, so it takes no new spend.
refusals.vendor_blocked: A blocked or canceled vendor takes no new purchase orders.
refusals.po_line_budget: A line can only draw on a budget line of the same project.
refusals.po_change_order_target: Change orders apply only to approved or sent purchase orders.
refusals.po_change_order_unpriced: Price the change order before approving it.
refusals.po_change_order_locked: A decided change order never changes.
refusals.receipt_order_state: Goods are received only against an approved or sent purchase order.
refusals.receipt_exceeds_order: This would receive more than was ordered. Check the quantities against what is still to receive.
refusals.receipt_line_order: Each receipt line must be a line of this purchase order.
refusals.invoice_match_direction: Only payable invoices are matched to purchase orders.
refusals.invoice_match_receipt_order: The receipt must belong to the matched purchase order.
refusals.invoice_match_project: The invoice and the purchase order must be on the same project.
refusals.invoice_match_mismatch: The invoice does not match its order and receipt. Accept the difference before approving.
refusals.invoice_unpriced: Every invoice line needs a price before approval.
refusals.invoice_state_conflict: Only a received or disputed payable invoice can be approved.
refusals.sod_approval_requester: Separation of duties: the person who started this cannot decide it.
refusals.item_id_immutable: A catalog item keeps its item ID and element.
refusals.submittal_order_project: A submittal supports a purchase order of its own project.
refusals.submittal_immutable: A submittal keeps its project and vendor.
refusals.submittal_transition_not_allowed: That submittal move is not allowed from the current state.
refusals.review_decide_rpc: Approve or return submittals with the review buttons.
refusals.transition_reason_required: Every state change needs a reason.
refusals.cross_org_reference: That item belongs to another organization.
refusals.rfq_response_lines_required: Add at least one quoted line to the response.

refusalFamily.separation: Separation of duties: someone other than the person who started this has to decide it.
refusalFamily.spend: Spend authority does not cover this amount. Ask an approver with a higher limit.
refusalFamily.other: The database refused this change. The rule code below explains why.

errors.notFound: This item no longer exists or you no longer have access to it. Refresh the page.
errors.conflict: That value is already in use. Choose another one.
errors.invalid: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.fields: Fix the highlighted fields, then save again.
errors.approvalPending: Your approval is recorded. A second approver is needed before it takes effect.
errors.fileScanning: The file is still being scanned for threats. Try again in a minute.
errors.editedElsewhere: Someone saved a newer version while you were editing. Copy your changes, refresh, and apply them again.

kit.moneyHelp: Leave blank when the price is not known yet; blank stays unpriced, never zero.
kit.reasonHelp: Every change of state records why, for the history and the audit log.

validation.currencyNeeded: Choose the currency of the amount.
validation.dateOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.
validation.score: Enter a score from 1 to 5, or leave it blank.
validation.accountNumber: Enter the full account number, at least four characters.
validation.checksum: Choose the file so its fingerprint can be recorded.
validation.emDash: Remove the em dash. Use a comma, colon or parentheses instead.
validation.definitionSentence: End the definition with a period.
validation.shape: Use the code shape for this level: DDDD.DD for a discipline, DDDD.DD.DD for a category.
validation.range: Extensions use .50 to .99 in the discipline or category segment.
validation.parent: The code must start with its parent code.
validation.quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
validation.lines: Add at least one line with a quantity.
validation.sopCode: Use SOP- and three to five digits, for example SOP-007.
validation.lineFormat: Check the format: one entry per line, as the help under the field describes.
validation.quizCorrect: Enter the number of the correct option, from 1 to the number of options.
validation.httpsUrl: Enter a web address that starts with https://.
